units.source_text: 子女三人，都还年幼无知，正在游戏。

en.t: The three children were still young and innocent, and were at play.

units.source_text: 夫人都把他们叫来，对他们说道：

en.t: The lady called them all over and said to them:

units.source_text: “我宿世命苦，今已断绝希望，对这世间毫无留恋，只有听天由命了。

en.t: My fate from former lives has been bitter; now I have given up all hope, have no attachment left to this world, and can only leave myself to heaven.

units.source_text: 你等来日方长，今后孤苦无依，毕竟使我不胜悲伤！

en.t: You still have long lives ahead of you, yet from now on you will be lonely and without support, and that fills me with unbearable sorrow.

units.source_text: 你这女孩且跟我走，前途是好是坏，也顾不得了。

en.t: You, my girl, must come with me for now; whether your future will be good or bad, I can no longer stop to consider.

units.source_text: 你们两个男孩暂时也跟我去，但总不能与父亲断绝，还得常常来探望他。

en.t: You two boys should also come with me for the time being, but you cannot break with your father entirely, and must still visit him often.

units.source_text: 不过你们的父亲不把你们放在心上，你们的前途十分暗淡，恐怕不得享福。

en.t: Yet your father does not keep you in his heart, so your prospects are very bleak, and I fear you will not know good fortune.

units.source_text: 只要外祖父在世，你们将来总可获得一官半爵。

en.t: As long as your maternal grandfather lives, you may still obtain some small rank or office in the future.

units.source_text: 但现今是源氏太政大臣与内大臣的世界，他们闻知了你们的情况，恐怕会看你们不起，

en.t: But the present age belongs to Genji, the Grand Minister, and to the Minister of the Interior; if they hear of your circumstances, I fear they will look down on you,

units.source_text: 你们要立身出世也是不容易的。

en.t: and it will not be easy for you to establish yourselves and rise in the world.

units.source_text: 如果出家为僧，遁入山林，那就叫我死也不能瞑目了。”

en.t: If you were to leave the world, become monks, and hide away in the mountains, then even in death I could not close my eyes in peace.
As she said this, she began to weep.

units.source_text: 三个孩子虽然不大懂得这话的意思，但也都皱着眉头哭了。

en.t: Although the three children did not really understand what she meant, they all frowned and cried as well.

units.source_text: 几个乳母聚在一起，相与悲叹着说：

en.t: Several wet nurses gathered together and lamented to one another, saying:

units.source_text: “但看古代小说中所记，即使是世间一般慈爱的父亲，到了时移世变之时，

en.t: If we look only at what is recorded in old tales, even an ordinarily loving father, when times change and circumstances shift,

units.source_text: 也往往会追随后妻而疏远前妻的儿子。

en.t: will often follow the wishes of a later wife and grow distant from the sons of his former wife.

units.source_text: 何况我们这位大将只有父亲的空名，在别人面前也毫无顾忌地看轻他们，

en.t: How much more so with our general, who is a father in name only and openly makes light of them even in front of others;

units.source_text: 想靠他提拔，恐怕是无望的吧！”

en.t: to hope that he will support and advance them is probably hopeless.
